source: Introspected live from app.mcp.server.mcp via mcp.list_tools() (mcp SDK 2.2.0, MCPServer). input_schema is authoritative and machine-generated from the actual tool signatures in app/mcp/server.py. `returns` is hand-authored from reading app/mcp/server.py's *_to_dict() helpers and the underlying Pydantic *Out schemas, since the SDK's generic output_schema for dict-returning tools is just {"result": {"type": "object", "additionalProperties": true}}.
transport: streamable-http, mounted at /mcp-server (reachable at /mcp-server/mcp), auth via X-API-Key header

tools.name: list_devices
tools.description: List devices, optionally filtered by type and/or status.

type.title: Type
type.description: cctv | iot | fire_panel | alarm | water_sensor | other

tools.returns: list[Device] — each: {id, external_id, type, name, location, status, metadata, first_seen_at, last_seen_at}

tools.name: get_device
tools.description: Get a single device by id.

device_id.title: Device Id
device_id.description: device UUID (the platform id, not external_id)

tools.returns: Device dict (see list_devices) or null if not found

tools.name: query_telemetry
tools.description: Query telemetry readings, optionally filtered by device, metric type, and time range.
tools.returns: list[TelemetryReading] — each: {id, device_id, ts, end_ts, metric_type, value, unit, payload, quality, availability, provenance, external_event_id, ingested_at}

tools.name: get_latest_readings
tools.description: Get the latest reading per device, optionally filtered by device ids or device type.
tools.returns: list[TelemetryReading], one entry per device (see query_telemetry for shape)

tools.name: list_incidents
tools.description: List incidents, optionally filtered by status, type, and opened-since timestamp.
tools.returns: list[Incident] with evidence always [] — each: {id, type, status, severity, location, summary, metadata, opened_at, updated_at, closed_at, evidence: []}

tools.name: get_incident
tools.description: Get a single incident by id, including its linked evidence.
tools.returns: Incident dict with full evidence array populated, or null if not found. evidence item: {id, incident_id, device_id, reading_id, note, created_at}

tools.name: create_incident
tools.description: Create a new incident hypothesis, optionally with supporting evidence.

location.title: Location
location.description: free-form dict, e.g. {building, floor, zone, lat, lon}

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: optional list of {device_id?, reading_id?, note?} to link immediately

tools.returns: created Incident dict, status defaults to "open", evidence populated from the evidence argument (see get_incident for shape)

tools.name: update_incident
tools.description: Update an incident's status/severity, or append a note.

status.title: Status
status.description: open | acknowledged | resolved | escalated; setting resolved also stamps closed_at

note.title: Note
note.description: appended to metadata.notes (a list), not a replacement

tools.returns: updated Incident dict with full evidence array (see get_incident for shape)

tools.name: link_evidence
tools.description: Link a piece of evidence (device reading and/or note) to an existing incident.
tools.returns: updated Incident dict with the new evidence row included (see get_incident for shape)

tools.name: list_dashboards
tools.returns: list[DashboardSpec] — each: {id, title, created_by, spec, version, created_at, updated_at}

tools.name: get_dashboard
tools.description: Get a single dashboard spec by id.
tools.returns: DashboardSpec dict (see list_dashboards) or null if not found

tools.name: create_dashboard
tools.description: Create a new custom dashboard spec for the operator dashboard app to pick up.

tools.name: update_dashboard
tools.description: Update an existing dashboard's title and/or spec, bumping its version.

spec.title: Spec
spec.description: when provided, replaces the whole spec dict (not merged)

tools.returns: updated DashboardSpec dict with version incremented by 1
